task: Tidy the benefits paragraph in the campaign landing copy.
exclusivity: A comma-only series nests inside a serial one: 'fast, cheap, and reliable' also matches the no-conjunction pattern, so no_final_conjunction is tested last and is reached only when no series carries a closing and or or. Semicolon separation strips every comma out of the series, and bullets remove series punctuation altogether, so both are settled before either comma rule is tried. The always and never rules then differ by exactly one character, the comma before the final conjunction, and the label is read across every series in the passage: a paragraph punctuating two differently returns 'other'.

Leave that last comma out in every list.

note: Keeping the serial comma is the more common instruction in current guides; dropping it is still standard in news writing, so neither is right on its own terms.

task: Edit the interview section so the quoted lines sit properly.
